description:
Use this when the user asks about an Indian company's BRSR (Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report) or ESG disclosures.

Returns the figures from the company's Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report as filed, by financial year, newest first: emissions, energy, water, waste, workforce and governance. `years` is 1 to 10 (default 3). Only the 1,000 largest listed companies file this report. A figure that is absent was not in the filing, or is not one DalalOS reads; it is not zero. Leave `include_raw` unset: the full filing is not returned here.

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
query.title: Query
